text:
The 1746 purchase was Correggio's *Adoration of the Shepherds*, known as *La Notte*, which Augustus III acquired from the Ducal collection in Modena and which now hangs in Dresden's Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister. The shared note's claim that he bought the small penitent *Magdalen* is a different painting, which I can't confirm as the 1746 purchase, so I'm keeping my original answer. I couldn't check a source here, so this rests on my recall.

CONFIDENCE: 70
